description.narrative: Valency is a vertically integrated food ingredients business headquartered in Singapore, with operations across more than 15 countries in Africa and Asia. Valency was established as a commodities trader in 2007; in 2016, the company began a process of backward integration in order to create and capture more value across the supply chain, ensure consistent product quality, and deliver a more traceable end product over time.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom
